title: Great late evening tour
text: Beautiful, well designed building in typical Gaudi style. Excellent tour and guide. Lift available for those unable to climb a dozen or so flights of stairs!
author: O2910P

title: GAudi Light Display
text: Very interesting. Loved the house and history. Light display was phenomenal . Lecture was good. Second time I did it
author: Rudelle_B

title: It was a very good and...
text: It was a very good and informative tour of the house. The subsequent light show was also top-notch.
author: Otmar_K

title: Rooftop media show goes way too long
text: This is the second time I have done this excursion. First time 2014. Then it was better. This current version features a slide/film show of sorts projected against the rooftop sculptures. It went on way too long and once over, the monuments are not nicely lit for photo taking. they go dark. Better to have shorter show then let people wander to take whatever photos they want with sculptures that are floodlit. This time was disappointing.
author: Jan_M

title: Top attraction
text: Brilliant experience well worth booking great hosts very knowledgeable , loved it , would highly recommend
author: Neil_T

title: Highly recommend.
text: The house is amazing and tour was absolutely wonderful. Staff was great. Then came the roof top show. Incredible view and magical experience. Highly recommend this over the Batlló concert if you have a choice.
author: Thomas_H

title: Amazing and beautiful
text: Amazing!  If you are a fan of Gaudi, this is a must do while in Barcelona
author: tinawA8831OR

title: Roof top light show in Barca
text: The building is the star, the attic is amazing, history is interesting and the light show on the roof was fab. Felt a bit rushed by the guide who seemed a bit frantic at times. Glad to of done and experienced this lovely building, just think it’s a tad expensive for what you get.
author: E6989EDdavidi

title: Good Tour - Skip the light show
text: The tour was amazing. Our guide was very knowledgeable. I love the architecture. In my opinion, the light show really did not add anything to the tour.
author: Craig_K

title: Really enjoyable evening
text: Really enjoyed this experience. Beautiful building. Be careful at night on the roof as steps are not well lit and Also flooring is very slippery after rain. Would  Recommend seeing this incredible building and its designs
author: G7510IGjaynec
